notes: Both final sheets are exactly 1440x1080 RGBA and split into 48 exact 180x180 cells.
The baked checkerboard was removed and replaced with real alpha transparency.
All cells have internal transparent margin and zero edge contact.

The supplied basic design source contained 46 major original cells. R1C8 ready_right was derived from the existing side-ready pose by mirroring, and R2C8 walk_back_b was derived from the existing back-walk pose by changing the lower-step phase.
These two derived frames should receive a later hand-drawn pass if strict anatomical handedness or a stronger back-walk cycle is required.
